learning_outcomes.text: Students know the cause and effect of electric and magnetic fields and can solve application-oriented problems.
They can describe the properties of metallic conductors, semiconductors, and insulators and name their areas of application.
Students successfully calculate simple electrical DC and AC networks.
Students are able to independently familiarize themselves with new subject areas and successfully apply the acquired knowledge.
Students are able to evaluate the significance of measurement results.

syllabus_topics: Electrical fields (sources of the electric field, Coulomb force, dielectrics)
Magnetism (sources of the magnetic field, Lorentz force, magnetic induction, matter in the magnetic field)
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded for a passed written exam. Participation in the exam requires successful participation in the practical part of the course.
